title: Parental Leave Policy
content: Employees are eligible for up to 480 days of parental leave subject to applicable company and local rules.

title: Parental Leave Policy
content: Employees are eligible for parental leave according to the updated 2026 global parental leave policy.

title: Contractor Parental Leave Policy
content: Contractors are not covered by the standard employee parental leave policy. Contractor leave eligibility depends on the applicable local contractor agreement.

title: Sweden Contractor Leave Addendum
content: Contractors engaged under Swedish agreements may request parental leave according to the terms specified in their contractor agreement. Requests must be submitted through the HR service desk for review.

title: Sweden Employee Parental Leave
content: Employees in Sweden receive parental leave benefits according to the Swedish employee parental leave framework and company policy.

title: Leave Request Process
content: Employees and eligible contractors can submit leave requests through the HR service desk. Requests requiring contractual verification are reviewed by HR before approval.
